name: Bella
headline: How I actually eat and train.
subhead: My week, written out — what I eat, what I train, and me in the chat while you do it.

inside.title: The way I eat
inside.text:
What's on my plate on a normal day, what's always in my kitchen, and what I change when I want to lean out.
Plus the shopping list, so you're not standing in the aisle guessing.

inside.title: My training week
inside.text:
Every session I do, in order, with the sets and the reps.
There's a version for the gym and one for the days you're stuck at home.

inside.title: The group chat, and I'm in it
inside.text:
Ask me anything.
What to eat before a morning session, why the scale went up this week, whether to train through a sore shoulder.

inside.title: Live Q&A with me
inside.text:
Bring the questions you're actually dealing with.
On camera, no script — just me answering what the club wants to know.

inside.title: Challenges we start together
inside.text:
Everyone begins on the same day, and there's a leaderboard.
It's a lot harder to quit in week two when everyone else is still going.

inside.title: The week you fall off
inside.text:
Because it happens to everyone, and it's the week most people quit for good.
There's a place for exactly that, and I'm in it.

inside.title: Everyone else doing it with you
inside.text:
People on the same journey as you, posting what's working and what isn't.
You can post, chat and connect with any of them.

lockedLine: Whatever you join at is what you pay for as long as you stay. It goes up for the people who come later, not for you.
